question: The Nandi Award for Best Male Playback Singer was instituted by which state in the year 1977?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Nandi Awards are the highest awards given for excellence in Telugu cinema, theatre, and television, presented annually by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The awards were instituted in 1964 and have been presented annually ever since.
 
• The Nandi Award for Best Male Playback Singer was instituted in the year 1977.
 
• The awards are named after the big granite bull at Lepakshi, a cultural and historical symbol of the Telugu people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telugu Cinema**

 
 
• Telugu cinema, also known as Tollywood, is a part of Indian cinema producing films in the Telugu language.
 
• It is based in Film Nagar, a neighborhood of Hyderabad, Telangana.
 
• Telugu cinema is one of the largest film industries in India and produces a significant number of films annually.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**
 
 
• Andhra Pradesh is a state in the southeastern coastal region of India.
 
• It is the seventh-largest state by area and the tenth-most populous state in India.
 
• The state has a rich cultural heritage and is known for its classical dance Kuchipudi and numerous historical monuments and temples.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Film Awards**
 
 
• **National Film Awards:** Established in 1954, these are the most prominent film awards in India that honor the best of Indian cinema on a national level.
 
• **Filmfare Awards:** These are one of the oldest and most prestigious film awards in India, presented annually by The Times Group to honor artistic and technical excellence in the Hindi language film industry.
 
• **IIFA Awards:** The International Indian Film Academy Awards are presented annually by the International Indian Film Academy to honor artistic and technical excellence in Bollywood.
